text: merge-plan lesson: Bob14 0.18.96 service coverage wave4 uses canonical entries[] manifest; merge-plan shows 34 auto-safe content steps and manual review for README, CHANGELOG, and scratchpad item merge. README may still carry stale 0.18.65 release claims, so normalize release identity manually.

old-manifest lesson: Bob10 cloud broker job-intent explain patchset uses older queuebash.patchset.v1 items[] shape; queue dev merge-plan reports zero entries/unsupported_manifest_shape, so inspect manifest items and diffs manually rather than treating zero-entry as empty.

patch-apply lesson: For older function patches, apply provider and queuebash diffs selectively. Drop version-only hunks when the merger base is already newer, then bump the final merged package version once all streams are reconciled.

root-evidence lesson: Root validation/cleanup/merge manifest files from older patchsets should be moved under .queuebash/dev/deliveries/<delivery-id>/legacy-input-evidence rather than copied to repository root.
